text_en: For the purposes of this Regulatory Policy, the term “Spam Call” refers to certain types of voice calls and shall include all calls where: the call is a Malicious Call, or the call is an Unsolicited Telemarketing Call; and Page 8 of 24 the call has a UAE Link; and the call is delivered, or intended to be delivered, in audible form- regardless of whether: i. the content of the audible communication is in real time; ii. the transmission is duplex or simplex; iii. the audible message contains a natural or a synthesised voice or other forms of sound including but not limited to music; iv. regardless of the technology used in the origination, conveyance and receiving of the call; and v. regardless of whether the call is answered. Thus, missed calls shall not be construed as being excluded from this Regulatory Policy.

Unless the concerned Subscriber expressly agrees otherwise, Licensees shall upon the occurrence of any of the following events by default immediately enrol the concerned telephone number into the DNCR: commencement of a new contract with a Licensee for the supply of telecommunications services by that Licensee. This includes pre-paid and post-paid, fixed and mobile, as well as resident and visitor contracts; assignment of a telephone number to a Subscriber; or renewal or extension of any existing contract for services with a Licensee.

In relation to a Target Number: a Person shall refer to the DNCR for guidance before placing any Telemarketing Call to that Target Number; it shall only be permissible to call a Target Number after verifying that the number is not listed in the DNCR; the Person shall not call the Target Number if it is listed in the DNCR; whereas the Person may call the Target Number if it is not listed in the DNCR.

Licensees shall implement systems to automatically detect calls which originate on their networks and are destined for an international premium rate number, the Licensee shall intercept all such calls and shall alert the caller by means of an audible warning. The call set-up process shall not continue unless the caller takes a specific action to confirm his/her consent to the continuation of that call set-up.

Without prejudice to sub-articles 15.2 and 15.3 above, the Licensees shall include the following provisions in all Qualifying Contracts and terms and conditions be they new or existing contracts: The concerned business Subscriber and/or Person shall not use or cause to be used the Licensee’s network and services to: initiate, make, or facilitate making Spam Calls; The concerned Subscriber using private numbers shall not use or cause to be used the Licensee’s network and services to initiate, make, or facilitate making Telemarketing Calls. The concerned business Subscriber shall not initiate a Telemarketing Call to any Target Number listed in the Do Not Call Registry. The concerned business Subscriber shall not initiate or cause to be initiated any Telemarketing Calls to Consumers between the hours of 6:00pm (18:00 hours) and 9:00am (09:00 hours). Telemarketing Calls shall not be used to encourage Consumers directly or indirectly to call or send a short message or other electronic communication to any premium rate number. All of the Licensee’s Qualifying Contracts and terms and conditions shall provide that the provisions of this Regulatory Page 22 of 24 Policy (including the provisions of this Article) are incorporated by reference as terms into those contracts, as applicable, and that it shall be a breach of those contracts if the business Subscriber or Person breaches any applicable provision of this Regulatory Policy (including the provisions of this Article). Those contracts shall further provide that such breaches may give rise to appropriate penalties or liquidated damages as appropriate, and contract suspension and termination. Other Obligations
